name: aipm-tasks
description: AI-PM tasks in Claude Code: a band above the prompt with open-task counts, and a sidebar with status tabs and task detail. Only in repos with .aipm/config.json; /aipm or the band's Tasks button shows or hides the sidebar.

token.title: AIPM token
token.description: AI-PM agent token (ag_live_..., AI-PM → Agents). Empty: uses the AIPM_TOKEN environment variable.

apiBaseUrl.title: API base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: AIPM REST API base, ending in /api/v1

projectKey.title: Project key
projectKey.description: e.g. AIPM. Empty: read projectKey from .aipm/config.json in the session's folder

orgId.title: Workspace (org) id
orgId.description: Optional x-org-id header; empty uses the token's own workspace

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the sidebar reloads the list; 0 turns auto refresh off
